data.title: CI Coverage Infrastructure Overhaul
data.summary: Deep dive analysis and fix of CI testing infrastructure to achieve TRUE coverage measurement by combining all test types (unit, integration, behavioral, regression)

sections.Problem Statement:
## The Original Issue

CI coverage combination was failing with 84% < 86% threshold.

### Root Cause Analysis

The CI architecture ran behavioral tests WITHOUT coverage collection:

```
smoke-tests
    ├── unit-tests (WITH coverage) ──┐
    ├── integration-tests (WITH coverage) ──┼── coverage-report (combines)
    ├── behavioral-tests (NO coverage) ──────── (NOT combined!)
    └── regression-tests (NO coverage) ──────── (NOT combined!)
```

Modules primarily tested through behavioral tests showed artificially low coverage:
- `cortical/reasoning/prism_causal.py`: 0% (actually 71% when behavioral tests run)
- `cortical/cel/sanity/compaction.py`: 16% (actually 90%)
- `cortical/cel/sanity/health.py`: 22% (actually 82%)
- `cortical/cel/sanity/migration.py`: 22% (actually 88%)
- `cortical/reasoning/prism_attention.py`: 15% (actually 87%)

### Initial Workaround (Superseded)

First attempt was to exclude these modules from coverage threshold. This was wrong because:
1. It hid actual coverage gaps
2. It violated the Metus principle of TRUE measurement
3. Modules could regress without detection
sections.Deep Dive Findings:
## Testing Infrastructure Analysis

### Test Directory Structure (427 test files)

| Directory | Files | Purpose | Coverage Collected |
|-----------|-------|---------|-------------------|
| tests/smoke/ | 2 | Quick sanity checks | NO |
| tests/unit/ | 236 | Core unit tests | YES |
| tests/integration/ | 21 | Component integration | YES |
| tests/behavioral/ | 91 | User story tests (Metus living docs) | NO → YES |
| tests/performance/ | 43 | Timing-based tests | NO (timing sensitive) |
| tests/regression/ | 10 | Bug-specific tests | NO → YES |
| tests/security/ | 3 | Security tests | YES (in integration) |
| tests/benchmarks/ | 3 | SLM regression tests | NOT RUNNING → YES |
| tests/hubris/ | 2 | Expert tests | NOT RUNNING → YES |

### Tests Never Running in CI

Found 5 test files that were NEVER running in CI:
- `tests/benchmarks/test_corpus_quality.py` - SLM corpus validation
- `tests/benchmarks/test_slm_regression.py` - Model size regression
- `tests/hubris/test_refactor_expert.py` - RefactorExpert tests

### Key Insight

Behavioral tests are "living documentation" per Metus philosophy. They test modules like:
- PRISM causal reasoning (`prism_causal.py`)
- CEL sanity operations (compaction, health, migration)
- PRISM attention mechanisms

These modules SHOULD contribute to coverage because they're real, tested code.
